scripts.start: export RELIFE_BIND=${RELIFE_BIND:-127.0.0.1}; concurrently -k -n web,worker "next start -H $RELIFE_BIND -p 3030" "tsx --env-file=../../.env src/worker/index.ts"
scripts.dev:mock: npm run mock:seed && export RELIFE_BIND=${RELIFE_BIND:-127.0.0.1} && RELIFE_MOCK=1 next dev -H $RELIFE_BIND -p 3001
scripts.test: tsx --env-file=../../.env --test src/domain/*.test.ts src/core/*.test.ts src/core/imports/*.test.ts src/core/auth/*.test.ts src/core/data/*.test.ts src/connectors/shop/*.test.ts src/ai/*.test.ts src/parsers/*.test.ts src/worker/*.test.ts src/connectors/*.test.ts src/rules/*.test.ts src/bot/*.test.ts src/ui/*.test.ts src/ui/share/*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: RELIFE_MOCK=1 RELIFE_AUTH_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_RECATEGORIZE_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_RECOVERY_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_QUICKLOG_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_GOALS_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_NEEDS_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_TOOL_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_RUN_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_ONBOARDING_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_SCHEDULES_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_NETWORTH_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_INGEST_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_MIGRATE_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_DATA_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_BACKUP_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_OUTBOX_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_HEALTH_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_IMPORT_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_SHARE_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_PACKS_INTEGRATION=1 RELIFE_MULTI_INTEGRATION=1 tsx --env-file=../../.env --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=300000 src/core/*.integration.test.ts src/core/auth/*.integration.test.ts src/ai/*.integration.test.ts
